mapper.sql: select io.id, io.inbound_order_id, io.inbound_batch_id, io.inbound_status, io.inbound_type, CASE io.inbound_type WHEN 0 THEN 'production' WHEN 1 THEN 'purchase' WHEN 2 THEN 'transfer' ELSE '' END as inbound_type_name, io.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, io.related_order_no, io.supplier_type, io.supplier_id, io.inbound_user, io.inbound_time, io.total_quantity, io.apply_time, io.audit_time, io.audit_user, io.operator, io.created_at, io.updated_at, io.remark from inbound_order io left join inv_warehouse w on io.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id and w.del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: update inbound_order set inbound_status = #{status}, updated_at = now() where inbound_order_id = #{inboundOrderId}
mapper.select:
select count(1) from inbound_order where inbound_status = 'pending'
and warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}
select release_id, release_name, CONCAT(release_name, ' (', release_id, ')') as display_text from t_input_release_main where is_deleted = 0 order by operate_time desc
